nsis.evidence: Build configuration identifies nsis-resources-3.4.1 plugins/x86-unicode and StdUtils.nsh; generated installer invokes StdUtils.TestParameter/GetAllParameters. electron-builder template default useZip=false extracts its app archive with Nsis7z::Extract; splash BgImage calls are conditional.
nsis.compression: electron-builder 26.18.0 NsisTarget.js explicitly sets SetCompressor=zlib unless packaging compression is store; this project does not select store. Its NSIS template toggles compression around an external app archive. NSIS bzip2/LZMA core compression modes are not selected by that command; the embedded .7z app payload is decoded by Nsis7z (7-Zip 19.00).
nsis.licenses: NSIS-LICENSE.txt documents core NSIS zlib/libpng, bzip2 and CPL-1.0/LZMA terms and the LZMA linking exception. StdUtils is LGPL-2.1-or-later, version 1.1.4.0 (SHA-256 B72E9013A6204E9F01076DC38DABBF30870D44DFC66962ADBF73619D4331601E); Nsis7z uses 7-Zip 19.00 code and follows 7-Zip source licensing. See StdUtils-NOTICE.txt, Nsis7z-NOTICE.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html for the full LGPL text.
